subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: If multiple, duplicate, or conflicting dispositions claim the same stale edge, or one disposition claims more than one edge, then the system shall leave the edge blocking and emit a currency/configuration defect naming all competing records; never choose by file order, recency, or apparent strength
intent: deterministic ambiguity defect and explicit unblock
fit_criterion: multiple/duplicate/conflict/multi-edge fixtures all fail identically under input reordering and perform no implicit selection; zero records follows FR-14's ordinary uncovered-currency path
